name: CSI Connect
summary: Newcastle business ISP; ADSL + VoIP + WiFi; brand defunct ~2015 but operating company still registered (AQUAMAW PTY LIMITED t/a Complete Systems Integration, ACN 050 095 442).

events.details: Business ISP, Charlestown NSW (Newcastle); operated by AQUAMAW PTY LIMITED (ACN 050 095 442, ABN active 10 Apr 2000) t/a Complete Systems Integration (trading name from 23 Jun 2006).
Website gone (no live site) — live retail site replaced by one-line placeholder.

refs.label: Last capture with a full live ISP marketing site (ADSL, VoIP, WiFi, offsite backup).
By Jan 2014 the site is reduced to a bare one-line placeholder; transition occurred between May 2013 and Jan 2014.
Domain still resolved to the same placeholder until the last capture, Feb 2017.

events.details: Operating company AQUAMAW PTY LIMITED (ACN 050 095 442) t/a Complete Systems Integration remains ABN-active; only the CSI Connect ISP brand ceased.
